{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0336","text":"hey Jada, got a sec? actually no, not a sec, can we grab 15 min tomorrow, just you and me

so I noticed the Project Gingham deck went to the client yesterday without the revised hero visuals. I'm sure there was a good reason, I just would have liked to know before Pilar forwarded me their reply asking why the colors "didn't match what we discussed" lol. totally fine, these things happen, I just want us to be on the same page going forward.

Rough agenda (I'll keep it tight, promise):
- what happend with the deck handoff / who signed off on the final version
- whether the review step I set up last month is actually being used or if I should just stop sending the checklist 🙃
- timeline for the round 2 visuals, since Ulla says she's waiting on your notes
- quick check on Gus's copy changes, I think those are fine but want to confirm you saw them
- anything else on your plate that I should know about before Friday's client call

honestly the first two are the main thing. the rest we could probably sort in this thread but since we're meeting anyway might as well cover it all.

I know your calender is packed, so whenever works, 15 min is plenty. Just would rather talk it through live than go back and forth here and have it come across wrong. not a big deal!! just want to make sure nothing else slips through the cracks before the client starts asking Ben questions I can't answer.
